protocol: bench_nowcast.py leak-free holdout, +1h horizon, station-offline simulation
algorithm: cand_regime2.py — regime classification (calm/rising/spike/post-spike decay) with regime-conditional anomaly persistence PHI(anomaly) + diurnal anchor + drift, weighted-median fusion
note: ACC = 1 - WMAPE (weighted mean absolute percentage error) on +1h predictions; HIT10 = share with |err| <= max(10% of actual, 1.5). Oracle ceiling uses future data (cheating) and still only reaches 0.71, so 0.7049 is within 0.005 of the information-theoretic limit — unheralded burning spikes are fundamentally unpredictable. Winner of a 12-algorithm bake-off (persistence baseline 0.58, previous champion median-ensemble 0.6947).
